this  Act,  an  Investigation  Officer  shall  have 
the
following powers of investigation: -

(a) 
require  any  person  believed  to  be  acquainted
with information or any fact relating to suspected
proceeds of crime including the committing of
an  unlawful  activity,  to  answer  questions  put
to  him  by  such  Investigation  Officer,  and  to
provide a written statement on matters specified
by such Investigation Officer;
(b)  video  record  the  conduct  of  an  interview  with
any person and the making of his statement;

(c) 
issue notice in terms of section 68 of this Act,
and  call  for  any  information  to  facilitate  the

conduct  of 
an 
investigation 
into 
suspected
proceeds of crime;

take 
steps 
that  may  be  necessary 
for 
the
identification, tracing, recovery and examination
of suspected proceeds of crime;
(e)  provide necessary protection and preservation to
